## Project thoughts

I am interested in exploring data related to voting behavior and election analysis. Specifically, I'd like to look at voter turnout and how it is influenced by a certain factor, such as demographics, voting laws, geography, access, etc. I would do this by observing trends over multiple elections based on the factor(s) that I choose.
